record.paper_title: (E,E′N) and (E,E′NN) Experiments at NIKHEF, Mainz and JLab and Open Problems in One- and Two-Nucleon Emissions
record.original_question: What fully unfactorized treatment of exclusive (e,e′p) reactions can replace model-dependent reduced-cross-section and transparency extractions, while consistently incorporating relativity, final-state interactions, and spin-orbit effects? The unresolved issue is how to compute and compare direct exclusive cross sections across kinematics without relying on factorized formulas whose interpretation changes with the choice of electron-nucleon current, optical potential, or transparency prescription.

evidence.quote: One certainly should measure exclusive cross sections instead of providing (model dependent) reduced cross sections or transparencies. On the theory side a consistent approach is desirable, where relativity and FSI interactions are appropriately taken into account in calculating an unfactorized cross section. In particular, spin-orbit effects should be investigated.
Thus T is a heavily model dependent quantity.

artifact.status_search_result: Relativistic distorted-wave impulse approximation (RDWIA) calculations addressing unfactorized (e,e'p) cross sections including relativity, FSI, and spin-orbit effects have been developed (e.g., Phys. Rev. C 70, 044608 (2004); earlier Phys. Rev. C 32, 1312 (1985)), and the role of factorization versus unfactorization has been quantified. The broad program of replacing reduced-cross-section/transparency extractions by direct unfactorized comparisons across all kinematics is partially realized but remains an ongoing research topic, with residual model dependence on currents and optical potentials still under study.

status_evidence.title: A(e,e'p)B responses: From bare nucleons to complex nuclei
status_evidence.snippet: Study of factorization in coincidence quasielastic electron scattering using RDWIA, exploring the role of FSI and spin-orbit term; quantifies differences between factorized and unfactorized approaches.
status_evidence.claim: Unfactorized relativistic treatments including spin-orbit FSI have been developed and compared to factorized formulas.

status_evidence.title: Final state interactions and relativistic effects in the (e,e'p) reaction
status_evidence.snippet: Five (e,e'p) response functions in DWIA using Dirac formulation, recovering Schrödinger dynamics to study off-shell effects relativistically and nonrelativistically.
status_evidence.claim: Fully relativistic unfactorized formalism for (e,e'p) cross sections has been formulated.
